main.name: fetch

payload.description:
Payload shape by operation (exact contract enforced server-side):
- Split work along module boundaries, name the files each Task owns, and avoid Tasks that all edit one shared file.
- commitment.update: {commitment_id?, content?, description?, due_at?, expected_version?, status?}; PENDING commitment proposal; no commitment is changed. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- memory.publish: {content?, description?, kind?, memory_id?, parameters?, title?, value?, visibility?}; PENDING memory proposal; no memory is published. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- memory.supersede: {content?, description?, kind?, memory_id?, parameters?, title?, value?, visibility?}; PENDING memory proposal; no memory is superseded. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- message.send: {body?, content?}; PENDING message proposal; no message is sent. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- session.action: {action?, content?, session_id?}; PENDING session proposal; no session is cancelled or steered. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- task.action: {action: {verb: "start"}|{reason?: string|null, verb: "hold"}|{reason?: string|null, verb: "release"}|{fresh_session?: boolean|null, guidance?: string|null, reason?: string|null, refresh_workspace?: boolean|null, reset_budget?: boolean|null, verb: "retry"}|{guidance: string, verb: "send_back"}|{override?: boolean|null, reason?: string|null, verb: "approve"}|{reason?: string|null, verb: "restart"}|{reason?: string|null, verb: "cancel"}, task_id: string, version: integer}; Copy the verb and parameter choices from work.read. The Task action system alone owns state eligibility; no agent override=true. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- task.adaptive: {action: "split", expected_board_revision: integer, expected_task_version: integer, items: [{assignee_id?: string|null, description?: string|null, title: string}], rationale: string, source_task_id: string}|{action: "sequence", expected_board_revision: integer, expected_task_version: integer, ordered_task_ids: [string], rationale: string, source_task_id: string}|{action: "replace", description?: string|null, expected_board_revision: integer, expected_task_version: integer, rationale: string, source_task_id: string, title: string}; Read Task version and board_revision from work.read. split creates ordered direct children under a non-executing coordination root. Children share the root workspace but keep independent agents, executions, and lifecycles and execute serially. sequence changes child order only; it does not create a dependency graph. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- task.dependency: {action: "add", depends_on_task_id: string, rationale: string, task_id: string}|{action: "remove", depends_on_task_id: string, rationale: string, task_id: string}; Both Tasks must belong to this Project; a dependency does not create parentage or workspace sharing. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- task.propose: {capability_class?: string|null, depends_on_task_ids?: [string], description?: string|null, governance?: {capability_class?: string|null, charter_revision_id?: string|null, document_revision_ids?: [string], milestone_id?: string|null, plan_item_id?: string|null, provenance?: object, risk_class?: string|null}|null, merge_config?: object, milestone_id?: string|null, parent_task_id?: string|null, plan_item_id?: string|null, priority?: integer|null, review_requirement_ids: [string], risk_class?: string|null, role_assignments?: [{assignee_id?: string|null, assignee_type: agent|user, role_name: string}]|null, task_state_config?: string|null, task_type?: string|null, title: string}; Copy review_requirement_ids verbatim from project.charter, or [] for none. Name owned repository-relative paths, give parallel Tasks disjoint files, and use dependencies to order shared-file edits. Depends-on IDs are prerequisite DAG edges only, not a parent/child hierarchy or workspace sharing. task_type: task (default), planning_task or discovery. plan_item_id: optional traceability to an item of the active execution baseline, e.g. pi-2. capability_class, when set: repository_write, repository_read, read_only, discovery_read or planning_read. priority: higher runs sooner. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.

payload.description:
Payload shape by operation (exact contract enforced server-side):
- project.charter.adoption: {action: one of draft_revision, base_revision_id?, charter_id?, content, expected_charter_version, expected_digest?, maturity, project_mode, provenance, render_version?, rendered_view?}; Draft an adoption or amendment Charter; only the user can approve it. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- project.decision: {action: one of record_candidate|record_effective, affected_artifact_refs?, affected_milestone_ids?, affected_task_ids?, decision_class: one of project_implementation, decision_id?, expected_project_version, options?, question, rationale?, selected_outcome?}; Record implementation decisions within the approved Charter. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- project.document: action=draft_revision {base_revision_id?, content, document_id, expected_digest?, expected_document_version?, kind, title}; action=propose_approval {base_revision_id?, content, document_id, expected_digest?, expected_document_version?, kind, title}; action=approve {content_digest, document_id, envelope_digest?, expected_document_version, kind?, render_digest, revision_id, title?}; Draft, propose or policy-authorize a bound Project Document. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- project.escalate: {need, task_ids?}; Ask the owner for the need blocking named Tasks. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- project.evidence: {acceptance_check_ids, action: one of attach|capture, asset_id?, caption, checksum?, content?, expected_milestone_version, filename?, kind, milestone_id, path?, source_run_id?, source_validation_id?, task_id?}; Attach milestone proof, or capture the artifact your verification produced. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- project.milestone: action=define {content, display_label?, expected_milestone_version?, lifecycle?, milestone_id?, primary_milestone_id?, provenance?}; action=revise {base_revision_id?, content, display_label?, expected_milestone_version, lifecycle?, milestone_id, primary_milestone_id?, provenance?}; action=set_primary {content?, display_label?, expected_milestone_version, milestone_id?, primary_milestone_id?}; Define, revise or select a bound Project milestone. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- project.readiness: {action: one of evaluate, milestone_id, milestone_version}; Evaluate milestone readiness against its exact version. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- project.release.request: {action: one of propose_candidate, milestone_id, milestone_version, readiness_digest, readiness_snapshot_id}; Queue an exact release candidate proposal; final release is user-only. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- project.review_config: {action: one of set_ci_steps, ci_steps, expected_project_version, setup_steps?}; Set independent review commands for subsequent Tasks. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
- project.validation: {action: one of record, check_id, definition_revision_id, evidence_asset_id?, expected_milestone_version?, governing_revision_ids?, input_digest, milestone_id, milestone_version?, observed_command_ids?, observed_task_id?, result, status: one of pass|fail|blocked|stale|unavailable}; Record disposable-checkout observations; pass/fail require observed commands, manual attestation is user-only. Payload <=65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.

Exactly one of path (inside this execution's workspace) or content (verbatim output). kind: screenshot, walkthrough_video, log, report or other (another label is kept, stored as other).

Payload shape by operation (exact contract enforced server-side):
- task.evidence: {action?: one of capture, caption, content?, filename?, kind, path?}; Capture bytes this execution observed; return the stored asset and checksum. Exactly one of path (inside this execution's workspace) or content (verbatim output). kind: screenshot, walkthrough_video, log, report or other (another label is kept, stored as other).
- task.plan: {action: one of write, content}; Stage this execution's Markdown checklist; publish only on successful settlement. Content <=1048576 UTF-8 bytes and at least one Markdown checklist item; planner or implementation role only.
- task.worklog: {action?: one of append, kind: one of progress|decision|validation|blocker, summary}; Append one concise observation with this execution's identity and role. Summary <=4000 characters. It never moves a Task or satisfies an acceptance check.
